title: Chapter 461 The End
content:
Chapter 461 The End

Hearing Jing vent his dissatisfaction, Yueming felt helpless.

Jing was regarded as the Lord of Disasters, the source of the disasters in the whole world.

If it weren't for the Ring of Silence given by Senior Lu, Jing would be standing here at this moment. Not only the Land of Gods, but everyone present would be doomed.

The aura of disaster will continue to spread until this place becomes a Jedi.

Yueming sighed, reached out and stroked Jing's hair, and said seriously: "Little Jing, I think Sister Xue is right."

Jing blinked and rewarded Yueming with a big slap.

"Humph, then you fight by yourselves, I want to see how you deal with that guy."

Yueming touched his cheek, didn't care, and looked at the battlefield with fear.

As time went by, casualties began to appear in the deserted city. Facing the unparalleled power, Yunqi's army was no longer useful.

The weaker ones could only stay in the back and watch.

The situation was a crisis.

"I didn't expect that after all the hard work to improve my strength, it would be useless to come here. Life is really full of disappointments."

Yue Ming's face was complicated, and he had some self-doubt for a while.

But at this moment, a warm palm gently fell on his shoulder.

"Why, are you going to give up now?"

Hearing this voice, Yue Ming trembled all over and turned his head suddenly.

"Senior Lu!"

Looking at Lu Daosheng who suddenly appeared in front of him, Yue Ming was immediately very excited. He firmly believed that this was definitely Lu Daosheng himself, not some phantom clone.

He knew that Senior Lu would not stand idly by at such a critical moment.

Lu Daosheng had a calm face, with a faint smile on his lips, and looked at the battlefield.

"Ah, the situation is a bit bad."

The situation was obviously extremely urgent, but for some reason, when Lu Daosheng said it, it seemed that he had no worries at all.

Yue Ming was anxious just now, but now he gradually calmed down.

"Senior Lu, I'm sorry to disappoint you."

Yue Ming stood up and bowed to Lu Daosheng with a guilty look on his face.

Lu Daosheng didn't look at Yue Ming, but said lightly: "Life is full of surprises, but the turning points of life often come from surprises."

"Only after experiencing accidents can you recognize your own shortcomings."

Lu Daosheng chuckled, "Young man, don't live in your own fantasy world, feel the real world."

After saying this, Lu Daosheng ignored Yue Ming's reaction and stepped out directly into the battlefield.

"Huh?!"

This sudden scene caught everyone present off guard.

At this time, Chi Shen, who was in the center of the battlefield, had already lost his mind, his eyes were bloodshot, and his murderous intent was overwhelming.

Seeing Lu Daosheng suddenly appear, Chi Shen didn't hesitate at all and attacked.

"Where did you come from, ant, die for me!"

The terrifying blood-colored energy rushed straight towards Lu Daosheng, which was extremely terrifying.

This power made everyone in Huangcheng look slightly different. They were about to open their mouths to remind him, but they swallowed the words hard.

This is the Lord of the City!

Sure enough, facing this powerful force, Lu Daosheng didn't care at all. He just waved his hand casually, and the power dissipated out of thin air.

"You?!"

Seeing this horrifying scene, Chi Shen's killing intent suddenly decreased. He stopped moving forward and looked at Lu Daosheng from a distance. His eyes seemed to have regained clarity.

"Lord of the City!"

Huang Shou and others looked at Lu Daosheng in front of them with excitement.

Chi Shen gritted his teeth, stared at Lu Daosheng closely, and said in a deep voice: "It's you, it's you!"

The battlefield suddenly became quiet.

All eyes were on Lu Daosheng.

In the corner of the Land of the Gods, Ao Qing and others were extremely excited to see Lu Daosheng. Ao Qing laughed and said: "No worries!"

Lu Xue also had a smile on her lips.

With Daddy's personal action, there will be no more casualties.

However, Daddy really took action at this critical moment.

In the center of the battlefield, Lu Daosheng looked calm and looked at Chi Shen without any fluctuations, "Haven't you been looking for me?"

Lu Daosheng spoke softly, with a little teasing in his tone, "Now I'm here, you can do it."

Everyone in the deserted city was silent, looking at Chi Shen quietly, with a little pity in their eyes.

Let you be crazy, now it's all right, the city lord has taken action directly, you can surrender.

Chi Shen stared at Lu Daosheng tightly, still stubborn.

"Do you think this is the limit of my land of gods?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng laughed.

"Do you think this is the limit of my deserted city?"

As Lu Daosheng spread his palm, an ancient city emerged.

The next moment, ripples appeared in the space in front of Lu Daosheng, and a series of terrifying figures walked out of it and stood on the battlefield.

"Lord City Lord."

Many ancient strong men saluted Lu Daosheng in unison.

These were the strong men who followed Lu Daosheng in his first life. They were either sleeping, wandering, or dying in these years, and were all brought back to the deserted city by Lu Daosheng.

When these strong men appeared, whether it was the people in the deserted city, the people in the Chaos Realm, or the only remaining Red God in the Land of Gods, they were all stunned.

How many cards does the Lord City Lord have?

Everyone shouted in their hearts.

And Red God's face gradually turned pale, standing there in a daze, his figure was a little desolate.

At this moment, he felt like a clown.

At the same time, he also knew that he had provoked an existence that he could not afford to offend.

Surrounded by enemies, Chi Shen had been completely defeated.

In fact, he had already been defeated from the moment he became an enemy of Lu Daosheng.

But things have come to this point.

Chi Shen suddenly chuckled and looked at Lu Daosheng and said, "Don't worry, I won't let you have an easy time."

As soon as the voice fell, in full view of the crowd, Chi Shen's body began to slowly dissipate.

Seeing this scene, everyone suddenly had a strong bad premonition.

Lu Daosheng's face changed slightly, and he quickly grabbed the bottom of the Land of Gods.

Boom!

I saw that the entire Land of Gods was annihilated in an instant, and everything that remained in it, including life, also went with it.

You know, Lu Xue and other creatures of the Chaos Realm are still in the Land of Gods.

But fortunately, Lu Daosheng acted in time and saved Lu Xue and the others from danger.

Huh~

Seeing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

It's finally over.

Ao Qing cursed at first, cursing the eighteen generations of ancestors in the Land of Gods, but he burst into tears when he saw Lu Daosheng.

"Master, you are finally here. I thought you abandoned me!"

Ao Qing didn't have the demeanor of a strong man at all, and he just hugged Lu Daosheng's thigh and cried.

This scene made everyone in the Chaos Realm, especially the strong men of the Sky Demon Clan, speechless.

Lord Ao Qing, so you are such a dragon.

Ignoring Ao Qing, Lu Daosheng looked straight at Lu Xue.

At this time, Lu Xue had just walked out of the brink of life and death, and was still in shock, but after seeing Lu Daosheng, her trembling heart quickly calmed down.

"Xiaoxue, you have worked hard these days."

Hearing what her father said, although Lu Xue wanted to say that you are not a competent father at all.

But she didn't say it after all.

Looking at her father whom she missed day and night, Lu Xue said faintly: "Dad, where is my mother?"

Hearing this.

Lu Daosheng smiled helplessly, "Your mother must have more important things to do."
